name: Lord of Darkness
effectText: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 2 Fiend and/or Fairy monsters. Cannot be destroyed by battle. Once per turn: You can activate this effect; Special Summon as many "Lord of Darkness Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 1000) as possible to your field, but they cannot attack directly or be destroyed by battle, and are destroyed when this card is destroyed, also you cannot Special Summon other monsters for the rest of this turn. If a monster is destroyed by battle: Inflict 700 damage to your opponent.
